BrochureContent.Content:
Horan Estates & letting agents are delighted to introduce a beautifully restored Victorian residence in a superbly connected City location to the Dublin rental market." 

No. 64 North Strand Road, Dublin 3 - First Letting This is a rare opportunity to rent a most impressive and substantial Victorian period property, originally built in the early 1900s and now presented in exceptional condition following a full, high-spec renovation. No thought or expense has been spared in transforming this home into a stylish and comfortable modern residence while retaining its period character. The property comprises four large double bedrooms, all ensuite, with two bedrooms benefiting from additional separate space ideal as an office space. The impressive tiled entrance hallway and extended ceiling heights throughout create an immediate sense of scale and quality. A downstairs guest WC provides additional convenience. The living area is warm and inviting, complemented by an impressive contemporary kitchen fitted with a full complement of high-quality appliances. The property further benefits from gas-fired central heating with a newly installed boiler and an excellent B1 BER rating, ensuring energy efficiency and comfort. Externally, there is an enclosed front garden and private outdoor space to the rear, providing valuable outdoor areas in this central location. 

North Strand Road enjoys a superb and highly convenient location, offering excellent accessibility to Dublin City Centre and beyond. There is an excellent public transport network nearby servicing both the North & South side of the city, including 12 bus routes, the DART, and Connolly Station. The IFSC, Phibsborough, Clontarf, and the coastline are all easily accessible, along with their extensive range of amenities and leisure facilities. The area has a strong community feel and is home to a growing selection of popular cafés, local restaurants, and independent businesses, all within close proximity. This exceptional property & first letting will be professionally managed by Horan Estates. Contact us today to arrange your individual viewing time.
